title: Clarinet first, then saxophone arrives
summary: Charles says bands used clarinet from 1909 to 1916 before saxophones came in.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Did he play most of the way through a number or did he just have certain places to play? No, he played through a number. Did the saxophones come in with the jazz combos from the very beginning or were they added later on? You said the saxophone come in later on,

yeah, that's right, because we used to use clarinet. And then the clarinet player took it. Then they double up on second clarinet. But the clarinet was the main one. All those bands was using when I went into the city of New Orleans, from 19, I'm sure from 1909 up until 1916, that's all they were using, clarinet. Then they began to use saxophone, because I've used saxophone myself. The same fellow you see I got in that picture there, he played saxophone also.
You mean Sam Dutry? Sam Dutry.
